## Overview

Placeholder shown when a list has nothing to display.

## Properties

| Property  | Attribute | Description                                     | Type     | Default              |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `heading` | `heading` | Bold headline, e.g. `"No recipes found"`.       | `string` | `'Nothing here yet'` |
| `icon`    | `icon`    | Emoji or short glyph shown above the heading.   | `string` | `'🍳'`               |
| `message` | `message` | Supporting sentence explaining what to do next. | `string` | `''`                 |
